comment: Although well-versed in his field, he is not a good teacher at all. He grades very harshly, and when you go to him for help, he will tell you the answers he wants and still give you a B to B+. Even after getting writing help, and him telling me I was very intuitive with my answers in class, my papers and resp papers were destroyed.

Professor Brandenberger teaches a lecture-heavy class. It isn't super boring, but it varies day to day. He does assign a lot of reading from texts that can be very tedious. Several of my classmates and I would often all receive B's on everything we turned in, even after talking to him during office hours. He is a nice person and a solid teacher.

kinda hard for an FYS but no quizzes. have to do 6 discussion papers and then there are two big papers. the reading is a lot but if you know what its about generally then you should be fine. really nice person and accessible for help but maybe a little hard for an FYS
Very smart man, great at guiding discussions and analyizing topics deeply. Also a tough grader.

Brandenberger is a really smart guy who you can learn a lot from if you're genuinely into history. He is very lenient on making up missed work and is approachable outside of class. That being said, he is a VERY harsh grader and really makes you work for an A or A-. There are 6 papers spread throughout the course with the final being 10 pages.
Brandenberger is an amazing professor. If you want to learn his lectures are extremely knowledgeable.
Fantastic professor. If you need to take a history class, take Professor Brandenberger!

Brandenberger is an amazing professor who is among the most knowledgeable in his field. Such a nice and genuine person and extremely helpful via office hours. In order to understand the content of the class, you have to do the reading. Also, Brandenberger assigns lots of papers where it would not be wise to hold them off until the last minute.

Nothing negative to say about Brandenberger. You'll get out what you put in; if you don't participate or read, you'll probably hate it. Discussions are awesome, readings are usually interesting, and he provides useful and quick feedback on papers. Go to office hours, submit rough drafts - he'll usually tell you exactly what he wants you to write.
Best professor ever!

He is a really great professor with interesting assignments and lectures. The only issue is that he is sometimes difficult to reach outside of class. This can be frustrating if you are trying to meet to discuss a paper.

Professor Brandenberger is a great professor. The classwork isn't too difficult. It's a seminar class but he'll talk a lot if the class isn't really saying anything. There is a decent amount of writing in this class but it's spaced out. He gives lots of time for revisions. A very nice and caring person. Take him for your FYS.

Super intelligent guy who is an expert in his field. If I'm gonna be honest, I had more work in this class for my fys than any of my friends had. If you are ready to grind, definitely take his fys because the topics are really interesting and you'll definitely get a lot out of it. Consists of a few large papers and several shorter ones.

I LOVE DR. B!!!!!!!!!!!!! He is an awesome professor. I took him because a lot of the reviews on this site say he teaches you to write, and I just wanna say that's 100% accurate. Take his classes, even if just his FYS!
He is my favorite professor I have taken so far. Genuinely brilliant and very kind to students. Tough but fair grader--will help if you seek it. Lectures are fascinating.

The first paper grade made me cry in the middle of the night. But he is absolutely amazing, charismatic, smart, easy to reach. He is a tough paper grader, but youll still love him. Gives cool but heavy reading, doesnt check if youve read it. Class discussion super fun!!

TAKE THIS MAN'S CLASS! He was the highlight of my semester. Very accessible, and gives great feedback! Will turn you into a better reader. Interesting and engaging discussion in class and his Harry Potter references are the best!

Brandenberger is definitely one of the best professors at UR. He was so helpful with reviewing essays and giving amazing feedback. My writing has improved so much from taking this class. There is lots of reading outside of class that is always discussed during the next lesson which was sometimes a lot. Overall great teacher and would recommend him.
He teaches you how to write! Take him if you want to improve ur writing 1

Hands down one of the best professors at UR. Dr. Brandenberger almost singlehandedly taught me how to write, and is ridiculously accessible. For someone who is so busy, he really cares about his students and makes time to provide insightful comments on all papers. Office hours are always helpful and engaging - 10/10 would recommend him to anyone.

Probably the smartest person I've ever met. He's truly an expert in Soviet history and one of the highest regarded people in the field. You learn a ton in the class, but be prepared to dedicate a lot of time to both reading and writing.

Hard work and office hours are a necessity. However, hes very appproachable and will give you helpful feedback on your writing, so meet with him. Super knowledgeable and passionate about his subject, which makes discussions/class fun. Take him - hell massively improve your critical thinking/writing skills, and I recommend him to everyone.

Dr. Brandenberger is the absolute best. Definitely take him before you graduate from UR! He fosters really interesting conversations and you learn so much. He also really cares about the things he is teaching and it shows. Cannot recommend him enough
Amazing teacher. Super hard class but worth it completely.

TAKE THIS MAN'S CLASS. Any of them. If you are at all interested in Russian history, or just history for that matter, take one of his classes. I'm about to take my third with him next semester. He is widely respected in his field for good reason. He is knowledgeable, accessible, and fascinating to listen to. I'm minoring in history because of him.

Great history professor. Lectures are old-school while still interactive and using fresh assignments. Ridiculously accessible, looking at drafts and offering quiz review sessions. Wide knowledge of the subject and good choice of reading material. Reasonable workload. Great choice for history majors or gen ed. Respected professor!
Excellent professor--this course came about as close as one could to making me want to major in history.

It's all about the papers with a test and a library assignment that serve as grade inflators. He's a tough grader and you should really show him a draft to endear yourself to him and let him know you care before handing in the final copy. Would not recommend his Stalin class to fulfill a Gen Ed like I did. Cold calls if you don't ever contribute.
I love him! He was the hardest professor I've ever taken, but pushed me to think and appreciated my work. I learned so much in his class, to say he is knowledgeable  would be an understatement!

Professor Brandenberger is one of the most passionate history professors that I have ever had the privilege to learn from. He goes above and beyond for anyone who wants to learn. His lectures are interesting and engaging and the workload is manageable. I highly suggest taking his classes as many times as you can!

You have to do the work, but he makes the class really interesting. He teaches it very well, and it has been one of the most enjoyable classes I have taken. The work load is reasonable, but you certainly have to do it. The class taught me a lot. I doubt you'll mind doing the work.

Very smart man who is passionate about history. Has a senses of humor and is very willing to hear different perspectives. Lots of reading and papers but if you are stuck he will help you. Genuinely nice person and a great teacher. Learned a lot.

This guy is passionate about Russian history and is willing to meet with you.  Class starts with a long intro to Russian history followed by the only test.The remainder of the class is response papers on readings & two 15p papers on select topics.All work requires an unrealistic amount of reading.  Beware or Stalin’s Terror will become your terror!

Professor Brandenberger is a great professor. Very knowledgeable in the Russian History. Also very helpful outside of class. Only downside is that he gives a lot of reading and his grading is a bit hard. The essays he assigns aren't many but he does require them to be lengthy!

Dr. Brandenberger is definitely one of the best teachers I've ever had. He is extremely knowledgeable about the history of Stalinism and the Soviet Union. His class is very balanced between lecture, class discussion, and group work. He required an extremely large amount of reading, but other than that, the workload isn't too bad.

Really good teacher. Tough grader and really pushes you to think, but I feel like I've learned a lot because of it.  Class discussions are really interesting and he guides them well, teaching without getting too lecture-y. He's very approachable and friendly outside of class too. If you're at all interested in IS, you should try to take him.

Dr. Brandenberger is a great teacher.  Very personable, organized, and guides conversation well.  His lectures are interesting and straightforward.  Although he tends to assign a lot of reading, he is very understanding and rarely gives tests or large essays but smaller essays spread out over the semester.

Brandenberger is easily one of the best profs at Richmond. He knows his material and is very passionate about it. He is witty and a bit pretentious, but all in good fun. He is demanding, but you'll learn a lot.

For an 815 CORE class, it was great. He really tries to make it a worthwhile class and i've learned a lot. He assigns a lot of papers and his tests are a little difficult. Great guy though especially when the subject is Russia
Passionate about the subject, extremely helpful outside of class, friendly, kind of a lot of work

Although he isnt an easy grader he isnt too hard either.  The class, russia in revolution, requires 6 500 word essays during the semester and 3 20 minute quizs.  He knows a lot and is interested in the subject which helps students not to be bored.  Helps a lot outside of class and is very approachable.

An excellent CORE professor.  He is always willing to help outside of class, even if it is through e-mail.  He is a fair grader and the questions that he sends out prior to class are well worded and allow him to lead a thorough and structured discussion.  I would consider taking another one of his classes in the future.  He is extremely likeable.
Great professor. Made CORE an interesting class and as painless as possible. I'd take another one of his classes for sure. Fair grader, and helps you do well in the class.

Good class, have to write 6 500-word papers throughout he course of the semester on readings.  Not very hard.  3 quizes during semester, which aren't bad if you spend some time preparing and go to the review session.  Very helpful outside of class, willing to answer questions.  I'm going to take his other History class (246)
